folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B277
folds.body:
Full354original lines reviewed: C1–6, seven omen rungs, seven scope outcomes, all staging/mark/outrageous options, engine sketch, safety/dials, both user-followup sections, actor/target/tier/scarcity/manifestation tables and every later consideration. Keep the user's actual qualifications: sufficiently capable ordinary characters can perform these acts, consequences depend on capability, and the number/spread is “probably” limited. These are character/means distinctions and a contextual scarcity preference, not a separate cosmic species, a universal top rank or a fixed number per life/world.

The first scoped-outcome table conflates run end with forced prestige/rebirth. Actual loss of a moment/body, abduction, continuing identity, branch/history rewrite, world change and a declared player run ending are different transitions; optional prestige is not the generic result of a large attack. Current [continuation/direction owner](DIRECTION_SUMMARY.md#reciprocal-return-and-intentional-loop-answers) and [AD50](RULES_INDEX.md#accepted-direction-rules-ad) qualify the early bored-god/instant-shatter examples. Run-ending threats are announced, have at least two authored exits and permit other plans supported by mechanisms; hard termination is a high dial. A cosmetic crack, rarity, or a vague omen alone is not that outcome contract. Genuine in-world traps can still exist; this does not invent a universally successful escape or weaken a qualified absolute protection.

Preserve C4's useful durable-before-presentation boundary under AR7, without making it anti-reload enforcement. A failed durable write cannot publish a real loss merely because an overlay played, and a successful publication/one-event receipt must not replay paid consequences after reload. Ordinary player save/reload remains a separate comfort/player-layer policy under AD22 and the current direction; a stored cosmic verdict is not authority to damage, delete or lock away the user's actual file. The explicit safety lines keep presentation fictional, private personal data untouched and the actual UI recoverable. A technical event payload can still describe the consequence of an actor's act; “acts by characters” does not ban useful event types or require a second cosmic executor.

Power, reach, target, identity and source conditions are independent. A large damage output need not reach a soul, other timeline, interface or entire save history. A subtle source-qualified means may affect a narrow history without all other god-like abilities. Relative scale and actor temperament can shape an authored choice, but do not determine it by personality stereotype or guarantee a new higher enemy/counter every time a player grows. Scarcity/faith/treaty/sleep/culling examples need actual local causes; they are not universal penalties for ascension or mandatory loneliness/lost humanity. Repeated actions, cheap/free causes and constructive blessing can fit the world (AD5, AD38).

The reading-aloud, every-world-legend, NPCascension/Notebook and player-looking-at-another-screen proposals all require actual knowledge/reach. Real receipts in the save are not automatically known to a god, reporter, future counterpart or actor on another branch. A narrative UI view is not proof of control or discovery; an observer can have a means strong enough, but it must be the actual one. Inactive histories/elapsed years and known rumors keep the current clock/information policy, not an automatic omniscient reaction. The tier table's hunger/debt illustrations cannot override ordinary comfortable food/recovery defaults in BHR16/AD19.

Current [UI_RULES](UI_RULES.md), prose-first direction and the specific player's presentation preferences qualify the elaborate spectacle sequence. Darkened borders, timers, silence, verdict fonts, screen cracks and irreversible-looking blackout are optional presentation, separate from simulation timing, actual action availability and acknowledged error states. Do not fake changed world time or take away usable controls to sell an effect. A text fallback can carry the same actual result, and reduced spectacle cannot secretly change that result. The user's receipts can inform a proposed style without fixing their personality or locking future choices. No overlay, scene, scheduler, migration, source reading, test or gameplay outcome was implemented or exercised in this pass; all distinctive options and original quoted direction remain preserved.
